answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The walnut holds work receipts rather than names, so the vertex of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the orchard of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
